x: This is a senior engineering leadership position overseeing technology across garden3d's family of brands, with Sanctuary Computer as the main base. The person will set engineering standards, ensure software is reliable in production, and build team culture while working closely with the company president. They should be comfortable moving between stacks such as Rails, Next.js, firmware and AI agent workflows. The employer says staff can work from anywhere, which makes it open to applicants in Kenya.

QuickMail, a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform, needs a technical support specialist to handle all customer issues from start to finish, mostly around email deliverability, DNS records and campaign setup. The role includes monitoring system health, testing weekly releases before launch, filing detailed bug reports, and improving the AI support agent and help documentation. Candidates need strong communication, technical understanding, critical thinking and the ability to work independently in a remote, multi-timezone team.

Tether is hiring a Product Engineering Lead to run the engineering teams building features and the app experience for QV.AC, a privacy-focused AI assistant that runs locally on users' devices. The role reports to the CTO, works closely with product managers, and is about 70% engineering leadership and 30% product input. Candidates need a record of shipping consumer products quickly, strong product sense, and a good grasp of what AI systems can and cannot do, along with excellent English.

Lemon.io is a marketplace that matches senior developers with vetted startups in the US and Europe, with work done fully remotely. Openings include React paired with Python, Node.js or Ruby, and each needs 4-5+ years of overall experience plus several years of commercial work in the listed stack, along with cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure). Candidates also need strong English, self-discipline and the ability to start delivering quickly. The listing is open to developers from many countries and does not restrict applicants by region, so it is likely open to Kenyans.

Fully remote consultative sales role handling inbound enquiries from small and mid-sized businesses. The advisor responds quickly, diagnoses the client's needs, presents Toptal's talent, global hiring and services offerings, and carries deals through to close while keeping CRM data accurate. Applications must be in English, and no visa sponsorship is offered. The posting doesn't restrict applicants by country, though that is not stated outright.

This is a senior engineering leadership position at a worker-owned creative collective, where the hire sets technical standards and builds engineering culture across its brands, working closely with the founder. The role calls for someone who can handle varied stacks such as Rails, Next.js, firmware and AI agent workflows while ensuring products are reliable in production. The posting says candidates can be based anywhere, so applicants in Kenya appear eligible.

Contra Labs is building a network of freelance 3D designers who review AI-generated 3D scenes and interactive environments, give structured feedback on quality, and help set benchmarks. Work is project-based, usually 5 to 10 hours at a time, with occasional full-time openings. Applicants need a strong 3D portfolio, solid grasp of composition, lighting, materials and animation, clear communication skills, and must submit a short intro video.

Semaphore, a remote-first CI/CD software company, is hiring a senior engineer to take product ideas from early concept through to production, including experiments that may become standalone products. The role covers backend services, APIs, infrastructure and focused frontend work, with daily use of AI coding agents while staying accountable for quality. Candidates need a record of shipping products independently, strong product and engineering judgment, solid backend and systems fundamentals, and comfort working in a polyglot stack (Go, Elixir, Ruby, React).

AssemblyAI, a lean Voice AI company, is hiring a Senior Research Engineer to improve its systems for large-scale distributed training, data processing and inference so researchers can run and measure experiments faster. The role needs deep knowledge of deep learning systems, including JAX and TPUs, layer-level optimization, low-latency and asynchronous inference, inference compilers and parallelization. The engineer works across research, infrastructure and production teams, and sometimes trains models and runs evaluations directly. The posting says the job is remote with no regional restriction listed, but it does not explicitly say Kenya or Africa is eligible.

The role covers developer activation and retention, early sales and partnerships, team and budget management, and performance metrics, with the aim of reaching 10,000 users.
